Mobile Expo web preview boots, demo-login-btn works via POST /api/auth/demo, /home, /shop, /dining, /social, /social/dreams, /social/dreams/studio, /social/room/[id] all render (no blank screens; the only blank was /social/dreams/advisor/adv_demo, which is just an unknown advisor id, not a rebrand regression). **NEW ISSUE FOUND (not in iter163 scope but caused by same class of bug)**: mobile /play-and-win (backend GET /api/games_v2/play_and_win) still returns the STALE seeded titles 'RadioLife Word Puzzle', 'RadioLife Memory Match', 'RadioLife Mystery Box', 'RadioLife Scratch & Win', 'RadioLife Lyric Hunt' and sponsor_name='RadioLife' on every EXTRA_HOUSE_GAMES tile — 14 visible 'RadioLife' strings on that screen.
